comment: Phase 7 lineage control: v1's 38,553 records trained with the exact Phase 7 recipe (clip 2000, huber, AdamW wd 1e-4, lr 5e-4, milestones 8/14, 20 epochs, record split seed 42), to be matched against NNUE-V2-CTRL-REC (v2's 76,605 records, same recipe). v1 and v2 come from the same Phase 6 generator and distribution, so the only variable is data volume - which is what the uncontrolled v1-vs-v2 match (P7-AB-V1V2, +63 Elo) could not claim, because v1 also used plain Adam. This pair is the first clean data-volume point, at ~2x, ahead of the pool's 100k/250k/450k curve.
